name: First Embers

text.short: Learn why red motes are gathering at the crossroads.
text.summary: Investigate the ember-sign and follow its first trail.
text.full: Ashford locals whisper about red motes moving against the wind. Find out whether the sign is natural, magical, or a warning.

discovery_summary: Mara Voss asked you to investigate the ember-sign.

text.summary: Inspect the red motes at Ashford Crossroads.
text.full: Examine the red motes and determine whether they form a pattern.
